subject.title: dotenv loader does not expand env references in .env files

question: Which dotenv sources, if any, should expand `$VAR` and `${VAR}` references, and what should happen when a referenced value is missing?
rationale: The code change is mechanically bounded, but it changes credential propagation across lower-trust workspace dotenv, trusted global dotenv, config env substitution, and durable service environment generation.

options.title: Approve scoped expansion
options.body: Expand only after workspace blocklists and precedence rules are applied, define missing-reference behavior, and add regression coverage for provider/auth variables and service-env staging.

options.title: Keep dotenv literal
options.body: Document `.env` values as literal and direct users to config `${VAR}` substitution, SecretRefs, or login-shell import for aliasing.

options.title: Defer to secret UX design
options.body: Keep this issue open until the related SecretRef/env-source direction decides how secrets should be materialized into process environments.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped expansion
recommendation.body: Expand only after workspace blocklists and precedence rules are applied, define missing-reference behavior, and add regression coverage for provider/auth variables and service-env staging.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history on global dotenv fallback and merged the adjacent state-dir dotenv safety work.
